scope: offline model comparison, not physical measurement; all height differences are left-minus-right

native_frame_alignment.scope: nominal URDF shoulder alignment derived from native axis directions and 174.5mm first DH row, not independently calibrated hardware mount

interpretation.link7: URDF arm_*_Link7 origin; coincident wrist joint origins 5/6/7. It is not the 95mm-offset native TCP or an independently measured gripper contact point.
interpretation.height_axis: Web renderer and geometry use base_link Z up. Torso Z is body_Link5 Z; equal to base Z for ideal pose_2, different in bent demo.
interpretation.signs: The three audited wrist sign corrections do not move Link7 origins because J5/J6/J7 origins are coincident; they do affect orientation and tool tips. All three target values are zero in ideal pose_2.
interpretation.native_tcp: Each published native TCP starts in a different arm-base frame. Compare directly only after documented/model-derived alignment; nominal mount comparison does not certify physical absolute height.
